  "description": "Compensation & Benefits (70%)\n* Handle monthly payroll to ensure accuracy and compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.\n* Handle monthly HR Reports such as Dashboard Report, Headcount Report, Attrition Rate Report etc…\n* Handle (SHUI) report and (PIT) report, submit it to relevant government authorities.\n* Develop and implement C&B programs and policies, including salary structure, bonus programs, benefits packages, and other rewards and recognition initiatives.\n* Ensure compliance with legal requirements and industry standards related to compensation and benefits.\n* Control Document Checklist for annual audits\n* Develop and implement an HRIS system to streamline HR processes and reduce workload.\n* Identify and prioritize HR processes that can be automated through the HRIS system.\n* Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the HRIS system and make improvements as necessary.\n* Support outsourcing management such as timekeeping, salary calculation if required.\n* To respond to employees’ concerns relating to internal salary and welfares policy, Payroll, Social insurance, PIT, etc.\n* Manage labor contract, probation contract and appendix contract for increasing salary, promotion, and internal transferring.\n* Coaching team subordinates.\n\nOther relevant tasks: (20%)\n* Coordinate the performance management and monitor the annual performance appraisal\n* Works closely with management and employees to improve work relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.\n* Provide coaching and guidance to the new HR members, especially in the C&B function, ensuring the provision of high-quality HR services.\n* Participate in the development and implementation of HR policies, procedures, or in special HR projects and initiatives as required.\n* Stay up to date with industry trends, legal requirements, and best practices related to HR operations and update to Superior;\n* Support or lead for internal activities.\n* Other job tasks within the HR & Admin Department assigned by the Superior.\n\nAuthority:\n* Lead CnB team & Adin team\n* Independent in implementing assigned tasks and complying with company regulations.\n* To be entitled to request and recommend superior to innovation, and improvements in work.",
  "requirements_text": "Tổng quan — Yêu cầu:\n5 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  3 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý  Đại Học trở lên  Tiếng Anh Giao tiếp thành thạo\n\nYêu cầu ứng viên\n* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, BA or related fields\n* 5 up years’ C&B experience in manufacturing industry (priority for ones with rotational shifts & 500 HCs up)\n* Attention to detail, high integrity, able to work independently\n* Good interpersonal and communication skills\n* Computer literate and well versed in Microsoft Office applications\n* Good knowledge in VN Labor Code\n* Ability to speak English in order to communicate with global colleagues and stakeholders\n\nKiến thức ngành\nThực phẩm / Đồ uống, Nông lâm ngư nghiệp, Sản xuất\n\nKỹ năng cần có\nQuản Trị Nhân Sự, quan hệ lao động, luật lao động, Giao tiếp hiệu quả, Quản lý hiệu suất làm việc, Tiền Lương Và Phúc Lợi (c&b)\n\nKỹ năng nên có\nTiếng Anh thương mại, Phân Tích Dữ Liệu Nhân Sự, Lập Kế Hoạch Chiến Lược Nhân Sự"
